label: AI PROMPT TRICK
lines: First I typed: make me a workout plan.
It answered with a list of questions.
Then I added: three days, sore back, no gear.
Now it built a plan around my back.

panels.head: AI ANSWER
panels.body: “I need a little more information.” Then a list of questions.

panels.head: PROMPT 2
panels.body: 3-day beginner plan, 30 minutes, no equipment, sore lower back.
